review.evidence: Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa) at monad:0x78999cc96d2ba0341588c60ccb0e91c6c33cf371 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603. At monad block 110016412 (0x68eb79c), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.638184+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation. On 2026-10-03 the exact owner/curator returned by Morpho were independently reconfirmed by RPC. Published allocator/sentinel addresses were each checked with isAllocator/isSentinel at block 110117695. Selector-specific fee delays and the published role census are recorded below; no exhaustive module-permission or independent-human-signer closure is claimed. Mint reconciliation remains not-applicable to this deposit-backed local share/fee-share mechanism; independent financial assurance, reserve-to-liability reconciliation and holder insolvency priority remain separate Backing observations, not a claim that such assurance exists. Parent durable-token issuance is inherited and is not resolved by this local share review. Calibration v2 custody retention: signer independence, actual key custody and signing-policy questions are restored separately for each identified Safe/EOA controller; known controller addresses and quorum evidence do not establish the human/key-custody facts. Reconciliation remains not-applicable because this is a local deposit-backed ERC-4626 share/fee-share mechanism, not an issuer supply-to-reserve reconciliation regime; parent durable issuance and independent financial assurance are not established by this local review. Supervision remains none: no local prudential or assurance-opinion credit is claimed.
